title: IFFT
text: Inverse fast Fourier transform (IFFT) of input, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Rounding mode} sets Rounding method; {FFT implementation}, {Input is in bit-reversed order}, {Input is conjugate symmetric}, {Divide output by FFT length}, {Inherit FFT length from input dimensions}, {FFT length}, {Wrap input data when FFT length is shorter than input length} sets the wrap or truncate the input, {Saturate on integer overflow}, {Sine table} sets the data type of sine table values, {Product output}, {Accumulator}, {Output}, {Output Minimum} sets the minimum value block should output, {Output Maximum} sets the maximum value block should output and {Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools} prevents fixed-point tools from overriding data. Values come from the instance.
